## What Do You Get After the Prompt?


You get an app that does work on day one, not a file to wire up. Each part lives in the same workspace, so the agent reads the same rows the app shows, and the automation acts on them.


Part What it does in the app


Your data Customers, deals, stock, and invoices live in projects that you can edit.


An AI agent Reads that data and answers your questions about it in plain words.


An automation Acts on the data: a reminder, an email, a new task. Connect 100+ integrations when a step needs another tool.


Here is the prompt from this week's product update:


> Build a CRM for my business that tracks every lead and deal, add an AI agent that tells me which deals need a follow-up, and email me that list every Monday morning.

## How Do Memory, Intelligence, and Execution Work Together?


Workspace DNA is the loop behind every Taskade Genesis app. Memory holds your records, Intelligence reasons over them, and Execution acts on them. The result of each run goes back into memory, so the next run starts from fresh data.


- **▲ Memory.** Your records live in the app, and you can edit every row.
- **■ Intelligence.** An AI agent reads those records and answers questions.
- **● Execution.** An automation sends the email, sets the reminder, or creates the task.


[Learn: Workspace DNA](https://www.taskade.com/learn/genesis/workspace-dna) explains how the parts feed each other.

## Frequently Asked Questions


What does Taskade Genesis build from one prompt?


A running business app in your workspace: the projects that hold your data, an AI agent that answers questions about it, and the automations you ask for.


Do I need to connect a database or another automation tool?


No. Your data lives in Taskade projects, the agent reads them, and the automations run inside Taskade. Connect 100+ integrations when a step needs another tool.


Does the Free plan include AI credits?


Free starts with no AI credits, and each build uses credits. You earn free AI credits with referrals and invites, and you can upgrade any time.


What does Pro include?


Pro is $10/mo billed annually, or $20 monthly, with 50,000 AI credits a month, 1,000 automation runs a month, and up to 10 workspace members.
